name: Monkey Climbers VR
summary:
Welcome to Monkey Climbers VR — a chill, competitive, and constantly evolving multiplayer experience built for the community.

Swing, climb, and vibe through handcrafted maps like the lush Forest and the all-new StartRealm — your gateway into a growing world of monkey mayhem. Whether you're showing off your movement skills, exploring hidden secrets, or vibing with friends, MCVR is built to be fun, fluid, and full of surprises.

🎮 Key Features:

🐵 Smooth, satisfying movement mechanics

🌧️ Dynamic weather
